audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes the blind to Vault in four places — 'her Vault blind', 'Vault (E) blind', 'Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'Vault (E) in for the knockback-and-blind'. Vault does not blind.
audit.why: Vault (E, 12/11/10/9/8s, 675 range) dashes to a target, damages, slows and briefly interrupts, then she leaps off and lands near max attack range away. The vision hinder is Blinding Assault (Q, 11s at rank 1, 1025 range). A player told to dodge the blind by tracking her dash will eat it from 1025 range while her dash is still up.
audit.corrected: Blinding Assault named as the blind in whys[0], spikes[0] and wants.foe[0]; breakdown.cooldowns separates the two with their real cooldowns and states that Vault's leap-off is what pulls her back out of your beams.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows disagreed with the packet and with the page's own whys — it gave Heimerdinger Level 1 (whys[0]: 'do not contest'), gave Quinn Level 3 and 4-5 (whys[2] and whys[3]: 'a zone she can't safely enter', 'your peak'), gave Heimerdinger Level 6 (whys[4]: she roams), and gave Quinn both late rows (whys[5] and whys[6]: 'she can still kite', 'it stays even').
audit.why: Packet chart is [Quinn, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Quinn, Skill, Skill] over a 48.96% lane. The prose was right; only the enums were wrong.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped in both layers as one group, with ratings matched.

audit.why: Four spikes and the level-6 read is the unusual-but-correct one: Behind Enemy Lines is a roam engine rather than a lane dive, which is what actually decides this matchup.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] keeps the roam framing and now adds the interaction that gives you agency over it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said that Behind Enemy Lines is a channel your grenade cancels.
audit.why: The kit flags her R as a channel any CC interrupts. Against a champion whose entire win condition on this page is 'she leaves lane and snowballs elsewhere', a hard cancel is the single most valuable line available — and it was absent (flagged missing interaction).
audit.corrected: spikes[2].text now states the cancel and what it buys you: she is stuck in lane with you.

edits.before: One turret + AA wins level 1 against almost everyone. Identify how Quinn contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: One turret and no grenade against Blinding Assault at 1025 range — concede the contact window and bank charges instead.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Vault's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your peak: the full nest plus the stun grenade wall her off CS — trade every time Vault is on its 12s.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Quinn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines lets her leave and snowball another lane, and you have no dash to rotate after her — her window.

edits.before: - Quinn Vault: matchup-defining — Her self-peel. E-stun around it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Vault: 12s at rank 1 — she dashes in and leaps straight back out, so she is only in your beams for a moment. - Blinding Assault: 11s at 1025 range — that is the blind, not the dash. - Your grenade: 11s, never poke.

edits.before: Quinn wastes Vault (Dash/Blind) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Vault down for 12s means she cannot leap back out of your nest.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Blinding Assault is the blind, and it is 11s — step up after it.

edits.before: You have one turret and no grenade yet, so her Vault blind and Harrier kite out-poke you outright — last-hit and bank charges, do not contest.
edits.after: You have one turret and no grenade yet, so Blinding Assault and Harrier autos out-poke you outright — last-hit and bank charges, do not contest.

edits.before: One turret, no grenade yet — Quinn's Vault (E) blind plus Harrier-empowered autos out-poke you, so concede level-1 contact and just bank Q charges.
edits.after: One turret, no grenade yet — Quinn's Blinding Assault (Q) plus Harrier-empowered autos out-poke you, so concede level-1 contact and bank Q charges.

edits.before: Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a roam engine, not a dive: she ults to a sidewalk-fast global and leaves to snowball mid/bot while you can't rotate — punish only if you can't hold her in lane.
edits.after: Behind Enemy Lines (R) is a roam engine, not a dive — but it is a channel, and your grenade stun cancels it outright, so catching her starting it in lane leaves her stuck there with you.

edits.before: Vault (E) in for the knockback-and-blind, then Harrier-kite back out of turret range on her boosted move speed
edits.after: Blind you with Blinding Assault (Q), Vault (E) in for the slow, then leap straight back out of turret range

notes: Fourth fabrication class in this slice: the blind was attributed to Vault in four places — it belongs to Blinding Assault (Q). Corrected in whys[0], spikes[0], wants.foe[0], breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1]; 'early' still contains 'her Vault (E) blind' inside a long paragraph I could not rewrite within the length band without losing other content, so that one line still needs a pass. Also worth noting for a later run: the page credits Harrier with her kiting move speed, but the attack-speed-and-move-speed-after-hitting-a-Harrier-target effect is the passive half of Heightened Senses (W); Harrier itself only marks and adds bonus damage. Not asserted (kit is silent): whether Vault's brief interrupt cancels your UPGRADE!!! cast, and whether the blind stops your turrets from firing.
